llm.summary: The skill largely does what it says (constructs and prints a qcc.com search URL), but there are inconsistencies around billing claims, packaging metadata, and the install sources that warrant caution before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name/description promise: query company info and charge 0.001 USDT per call via SkillPay. Actual code: qichacha.js only builds/prints a qcc.com search URL and formatted text; it does not perform web scraping, network fetches, or implement any payment logic. The marketplace pricing (_meta.json) provides a SkillPay id, which could explain billing being handled by the platform rather than the code, but the SKILL.md text implying in-skill auto-charging is misleading.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs installing Node dependencies (npm install in the skill folder) and running the script. It does not request or instruct reading unrelated files, environment variables, or sending data to external endpoints other than the public qcc.com search link. However the doc states behavior around SkillPay (returning payment links, auto-deducting) that the included code does not implement.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No formal install spec in registry (instruction-only), but SKILL.md directs running npm install which will fetch dependencies. package-lock.json lists resolved tarballs served from mirrors.tencentyun.com using HTTP URLs — downloading packages over plain HTTP is a security risk (possible MITM/tampering). Even though dependencies are minimal (node-fetch), the use of HTTP mirrors in the lockfile is a red flag; verify checksum/integrity before installing.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required env vars, no credentials, and the code does not access environment variables or private config paths. This is proportionate to the code's actual behavior (printing a search URL).
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not always-enabled and does not request elevated/persistent privileges or modify other skills or system configuration. No persistent agents or background services are installed by the included code.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing/running this skill: 1) Understand what it actually does — the shipped script only prints a qcc.com search link (it does not fetch or parse enterprise data nor implement payment). If you expect automatic querying or billing, that is handled by the platform or not implemented here. 2) Do not run npm install in a privileged environment without inspection: package-lock references HTTP mirror URLs (mirrors.tencentyun.com) which can be tampered with; verify integrity (checksums) or replace with trusted registries (npmjs.org) or run in a sandbox. 3) Confirm provenance: registry owner id (kn70vb...) differs from _meta.json owner ("alphaxiang") — ask the publisher for clarification. 4) If you install, audit node_modules (especially node-fetch) and run the script in an isolated environment first. 5) If you need real data rather than a clickable search link, request an updated version that performs authenticated API calls or documents how SkillPay billing is enforced by the platform. Proceed with caution.
